Your favorite contractor in Essex, Passaic, Morris, and Bergen Counties!

Our number one Priority is to take great care of you and your home in the most professional way in a moment’s notice.

SCHEDULE SERVICE
 
CALL: 973-435-0251
Our Specialties:
Plumbing

You use the plumbing in your home every day for a variety of purposes, often in ways that you don’t even think about. But when something goes wrong with the plumbing, you’ll definitely notice the negative effect it has on your daily life! You can always reach our skilled, licensed plumbers to schedule the service to take care of problems like clogged drains, a broken garbage disposal, pipe leak repairs, or anything else. In addition to fixing plumbing problems, we also handle new plumbing installations, such as sump pumps, tankless water heaters, and new piping. Talk to us today to find out more about our extensive plumbing services.

LEARN MORE ABOUT PLUMBING

Drain and Sewer

Residential plumbing consists of two sections: the freshwater side that brings water into the home and to the taps and appliances, and the wastewater side that cleanly and hygienically removes wastewater and solid waste out to the sewer system. Seeing that your drains and sewer line remain in the best shape so you won’t have to worry about them is a key part of our job. We handle such important services as drain cleaning (using the best in current hydro-jetting technology), video pipe inspections, and complete sewer line replacements. Don’t hesitate to call us whenever you believe that your drains and sewer line are in trouble.

LEARN MORE ABOUT DRAIN AND SEWER

Water Treatment Systems

The quality of the water that enters homes has become a major concern for more and more people. Do you know what’s in the water that you and your family drink and use to shower and clean with? If you think there’s a reason to be worried, or if you simply wish to take special precautions, schedule water testing with us. We’ll then determine what type of whole-house water treatment system will give you the purest water possible. We install a variety of different treatment systems to help clean your water, such as UV water purifiers, water softeners, and water filtration systems.

LEARN MORE ABOUT WATER TREATMENT SYSTEMS

Air Conditioning

Every one of our employees is committed to seeing that you’re satisfied with the work we do. That’s why you should call us when you’re searching for the best and most energy-efficient way to keep your house cooled down during the summer. Are you searching for a new air conditioner for your home, or is it time to replace your old AC with a high-efficiency new model? Is your current air conditioner in need of quick repairs to get it working once more? Or are you ready to arrange for regular spring maintenance to prep your cooling system for summer? We handle all of these jobs with professionalism and a high level of craftsmanship.

LEARN MORE ABOUT AIR CONDITIONING

Heating

Maintaining a warm home during a New Jersey winter is something that takes the assistance of experienced HVAC professionals. Our team of heating experts will see that you have the right heater, working in prime condition, to keep your household safe and comfortable through the winter months. We install many types of heaters, such as furnaces, boilers, radiant heating systems, ductless mini splits, and heat pumps. Whenever you need fast repairs, we’re standing by to arrange for same-day service so that you won’t have to suffer in the cold for long. No matter the job we do, we’ll go through it with you so you’re informed every step of the way.

LEARN MORE ABOUT HEATING

Indoor Air Quality

There’s another way that we can help improve your home comfort. We provide indoor air quality services to remove unwanted particles and other pollutants from circulating through your home. This includes installing air filters in the HVAC system, pairing them up with air purifiers, and installing humidifiers to deal with the dry air during parts of the year. You can trust to our customer service-focused team of professionals to see that you receive only the best when it comes to indoor air quality. Call MarGo Plumbing Heating Cooling Inc. today and find out why so many other homeowners have picked us for their comfort services.

LEARN MORE ABOUT INDOOR AIR QUALITY

HOME / ABOUT
A Bit About MarGo Plumbing Heating Cooling Inc.
Call our hotline: 973-435-0251

When choosing an HVAC provider in Cedar Grove and Essex County, it’s important to focus on the things that matter. Affordable rates, high-quality products and solutions, speedy service, and technicians who are friendly and knowledgeable—these are why MarGo Plumbing Heating Cooling Inc. has been in the business since 1998.

Our number one priority is taking great care of our customers and their homes in the most professional way possible.
We’ve earned our reputation by always providing the highest level of quality and honesty while in your home and around the community.
We want every customer to know that we will always do the right thing for our customers.

We don’t focus on sales and quick fixes. We build relationships, build our community, and help homeowners who are struggling.

If you’re looking for a team you can trust, then we think you should give MarGo Plumbing Heating Cooling Inc. a call.

What You Should Know

When you call our number to schedule HVAC or plumbing services in Cedar Grove, NJ, you can expect to receive same-day service. When we show up at your home, we aren’t "clocking in." We charge by the job, not by the hour. That means that you’ll get an accurate price upfront, not an "estimate" that is subject to wild fluctuations, especially in the upward direction. We don’t start the work until you’ve signed off on the price. All of our technicians are honest, and we stand by our work as individuals and as a company. We care about our customers, because we know that the most important people to our business are the ones that we are working for.

Our History & Values

MarGo Plumbing Heating Cooling Inc. was started more than 20 years ago, established in 1998. When we were starting out, we saw what we believed to be poor customer service running rampant in the industry. We realized that in order to be the best in the business, we needed to be honest and to provide customer service that lived up to the high standards set forth by our technical services. This is the same driving force that propels our company forward today.

Our company does not hold any value if that value is not obvious to our clients. That’s why we make sure that our phones are always answered, and why we strive to book same-day customer service. Our trucks are fully stocked and come ready to repair or replace any systems and components in need. We also clean up after ourselves and leave behind a workplace cleaner than it was upon our arrival. When you allow us the privilege of working in your home and on your property, we show it the respect that it deserves.

Ask About Our Home Service Plan

We like to keep our clients happy long after the installation or replacement work is done, which is why we offer membership in our Home Service Plan. When you enroll in this plan, you’ll be next in line the day you encounter an emergency or breakdown with our system. We offer plumbing, heating, and air conditioning service plans give you an annual inspection on each of these systems, meaning that we visit three times a year to ensure that each is running as it should. You also won’t pay dispatch fees or emergency service fees. Should repairs be necessary, you even get a 10% discount! Call now for more details.
